issue_context.title: Add an EVP demo for signatures using EC
issue_context.body:
Use a named curve.  Do both validation and signature generation.

It should be the current best practice (fetch), have proper error handling and resource allocation/deallocation and be in the style of a known answer test.
comments: The comment related to KAT here is misleading.. KATS can only be done on verify.. For this example a sign and verify is sufficient.

review_comments: Another small NIT: Move #include <openssl/decoder.h> up one line above "EVP_signature_demo.h"
Done in latest upload, thanks for your comments.

You no longer need sig_alg here..
It was being used to get a size which was not needed now..
